For [strings](/docs/shell/commands/categories/strings/).

<div class='command-title'>Gather word count statistics on the text.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> str stats {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| string | record |
## Examples

Count the number of words in a string.
```nu
> "There are seven words in this sentence" | str stats
╭───────────────┬────╮
│ lines         │ 1  │
│ words         │ 7  │
│ bytes         │ 38 │
│ chars         │ 38 │
│ graphemes     │ 38 │
│ unicode-width │ 38 │
╰───────────────┴────╯
```

Counts unicode characters.
```nu
> '今天天气真好' | str stats
╭───────────────┬────╮
│ lines         │ 1  │
│ words         │ 6  │
│ bytes         │ 18 │
│ chars         │ 6  │
│ graphemes     │ 6  │
│ unicode-width │ 12 │
╰───────────────┴────╯
```

Counts Unicode characters correctly in a string.
```nu
> "Amélie Amelie" | str stats
╭───────────────┬────╮
│ lines         │ 1  │
│ words         │ 2  │
│ bytes         │ 15 │
│ chars         │ 14 │
│ graphemes     │ 13 │
│ unicode-width │ 13 │
╰───────────────┴────╯
```
